messages:
Nora Patel: Heads up - BlueRidge Dataworks sent INV-2026-1345 for May data egress ($24,512.50) but invoice has no PO and charges look higher than our contract rates. Vendor references BRD-77. Can AP hold?
Ethan Silva: @Nora link the invoice and vendor email please. I'll check PO system and contract.
Nora Patel: link -> https://files.redwood/test/invoices/INV-2026-1345.pdf. Vendor note: 'per contract BRD-77'. No PO number printed.
AP Bot: Invoice INV-2026-1345 uploaded. Status: pending PO match / exception hold.
Carlos Ruiz: Searching for PO - nothing matching BRD-77. Contract BRD-77 exists in Contracts DB but rate table shows $0.12/GB; invoice math implies $0.16/GB.
Maya Singh: That's a substantial variance. We should not auto-pay until vendor confirms billing calc or issues corrected invoice/credit. @Ethan can you confirm whether there was an approved change order?
Ethan Silva: No change orders found for BRD-77. Procurement shows standard renewal in Jan but no rate increase approved.
Nora Patel: Vendor email thread attached says "applied new pricing per market" 1/May. They didn't send a signed amendment.
Carlos Ruiz: Two tracks: 1) Open dispute and hold payment, ask vendor to provide signed amendment or corrected invoice; 2) If business confirms service and accepts cost, create retro PO with justification. I prefer dispute first.
Maya Singh: Agreed. I'll flag this to the product owner for business validation but hold payment. Create dispute ticket.
AP Bot: Dispute ticket created: DT-2026-332 (linked to INV-2026-1345). Invoice placed on hold.
Ethan Silva: Notifying vendor procurement contact: "Please provide signed amendment or reissued invoice reflecting contracted rates within 7 days, otherwise issue credit note." I'll CC contracts.
Nora Patel: Noted. Adding note to invoice record: 'rate variance - awaiting vendor response'.
Carlos Ruiz: If vendor provides signed amendment, we can approve and create PO retroactive to cover the delta for this period only. If they provide credit, we'll apply credit and pay remaining.
Maya Singh: Product owner replied: traffic spike legitimate and service accepted, but they will not approve paying higher rate without amendment. Approve dispute hold.
AP Bot: Vendor notified. Awaiting vendor response. Next follow-up in 5 business days.
Nora Patel: Thanks all. I'll update when vendor replies. If no response by follow-up, we'll escalate to procurement and legal.
AP Bot: Thread update: INV-2026-1345 status -> On hold (dispute DT-2026-332).
